response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack and systems software engineer with strong experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and general software craftsmanship, but the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements for this role: native Japanese proficiency, Linux kernel investigation/modification, embedded networking, or security technologies like MACsec/802.1X. His C/C++ experience is limited and dated (2014-2015), and there is no networking, switch, or embedded systems background. This is a fundamental mismatch for a security-focused embedded networking role requiring native Japanese.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering career with senior/staff titles
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Strong testing/TDD culture and cross-domain adaptability (web, mobile, embedded-adjacent robotics)
concerns: No native or any Japanese language proficiency listed, which is a hard requirement
No demonstrated Linux kernel investigation or source-code modification experience
No experience with required security/networking technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching, NETCONF, SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security domain experience
